svg.title: Vale submits an emergency request while Ila supplies the paper flood warning.
svg.desc: At the server-cupboard threshold, Vale enters a Mission-level emergency request on the silver tablet. Ila holds open the red ledger at the timestamped flood warning, while Riju shows the quarantined terminal and Cecil compares both devices.

text.tspan: preserving the source warning and reason.
